sourceScope: Current working tree, including pre-existing staged changes; no application source edits made for this audit.

native.verification: Independent Get-FileHash and read-only REA open_binary. No game process started.

testResults.limits: Socket-free Node tests only. No fresh original-server, native graphical/GPU, hardware input or mixed-client acceptance. Existing accepted/rejected receipts inspected with their scoped limits.

linearExportPolicy: Automatic review rejected detailed internal evidence export. Reduced player-facing issue text is used; source paths, hashes, commands, logs and detailed findings stay in this local ledger.

findings.title: Resolve intermittent gameplay disconnects and stalled world entry
findings.gap: Some admission and reconnect paths terminate or stall before gameplay is ready. Later successful attempts have not established the cause.
acceptance: Identify the actual close or stalled boundary and correct it without masking failures with retries.
Complete repeated character selection, world entry and reconnect with responsive controls and clean disconnect.
Preserve evidence for failed runs and distinguish transport failure from intentional shutdown.
findings.details: Retained NPC encounter fails at 30501ms with StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_NONE/poll0 before any combat stimulus; Cleric reconnect resets around30s; Wizard first-world ACK and direct-handoff framing stalls are distinct retained symptoms. No timeout owner or common cause is proven. Do not label all symptoms one diagnosed bug.
findings.label: Bug

findings.title: Restore complete character-continuity validation for handoffs
findings.gap: The expanded character proof no longer fits the validation capture boundary. This blocks the current continuity check before it can compare the transferred character.
acceptance: Accept representative complete characters while keeping diagnostic storage bounded.
Retain spellbooks, coverage and completeness checks; detect meaningful character changes.
Pass the composed continuity and recovery validation before original-server acceptance.
findings.details: Fresh 2026-11-09 run: all8 semantic-chain tests fail at DirectHandoffCapture.bounded via HostCheck.digest. Public installed Wizard proof serializes to70321 JS characters against32768; forbidden-field regex is false, complete=true, scope selected-character-fields-and-spells-v2. Existing37-pass documentation used earlier helper; expanded helper was never composed. Harness-only failure, not proof production transfers corrupt characters.
findings.label: Bug

findings.title: Complete cross-server cancellation, failure recovery and character continuity
findings.gap: Basic cross-server round trips work. Cancellation, unavailable destinations, retry and broader character continuity still need complete acceptance on the current direct route.
acceptance: Cancel during preparation, source release, connection and content loading; recover to a usable browser.
Fail an unavailable destination, then successfully rejoin without stale menus or resources.
Compare transferred and saved character fields, arrival location and new server content using actual server outcomes.
findings.details: Current direct-route v8 accepts21 checks/three worlds A-B-A, raw download/upload hashes, arrival waypoints, catalogs, cleanup. Retire-boundary cancel/failure prepared29 mocked checks; real recovery unrun; browser-return concern remains. Earlier bridge-based recovery/NWSync passes do not accept this direct route.
findings.label: Improvement

findings.title: Close remaining crash and shutdown-lifetime failures

acceptance: Capture useful fault and ownership evidence for retained failure scenarios.

Complete repeatable normal-heap runs without forced exits or leaked owners.
findings.details: Do not refile already-fixed audio survivor, peer cancellation queue, coroutine or force_draw fence defects as untouched. Retained weather shader-cache heap corruption and earlier audio/shutdown AVs lack demonstrated original fault cause. Treat independent signatures separately during investigation.
